description: Reads, creates, changes and deletes dashboard widgets. A created widget stays on the dashboard. list returns IDs, names, each widget's dashboard view (viewId, null for the main dashboard) and its current layout within that view; get (ids) returns saved configuration and access-filtered results. A chart is created with name, measure, displayOptions, expectedRevision and idempotencyKey. displayOptions.displayType must fit the measure: number needs groupBy null, areaChart needs groupBy.dateInterval, rankedTable needs a grouping and funnelChart needs a single-choice grouping field; other chart styles accept any grouping. A chart is updated with id, expectedVersion, expectedRevision, idempotencyKey and changed fields; measure and displayOptions replace the complete previous value. Results preserve exact decimal strings and missing, restricted or error states. Activity timelines use kind activityTimeline, name, activityQuery, expectedRevision, idempotencyKey and showFilters. activityQuery scopes stable record/type IDs and combines typed inclusion/exclusion filters; updates also require expectedVersion. Calendar widgets use kind calendar and calendarQuery: layout upcoming lists the records of the coming days (days, today included) with an overdue section for earlier dates (showOverdue) and an optional amount column; layout month shows each day of the current month as a heat grid with a count, or the sum of amountFieldId with aggregation sum. dateFieldId must be a date, date-time, date range or date-time range field of the source list; a range puts each record on the day it starts and counts as overdue once it has ended; timeZone sets today and the day of date-time values. get with a calendar widget also accepts window {from, to} (at most 42 days) to read another month or one day. Map widgets use kind map and mapQuery: each record appears at the location stored with its address field (the building after an address lookup, otherwise the centre of its postal code), colorFieldId colors pins by a single-choice field, sizeFieldId sizes them by a number or currency field, detailFieldId adds a field to the popover; results report records without a location. Both read the same filters as chart sources and return only records and values the viewer may read. isTemplate controls sharing of configuration; viewers still need access to the underlying data. Position and size: layout {x, y, w, h} on the 12-column desktop grid (rows of 54 px with 12 px gaps) is optional on create and update; without it a new widget is auto-placed in the first free spot with a size that fits its display type, and an existing widget keeps its place. A layout that overlaps another widget is refused, widgets float up into empty rows above them, and the result returns the saved layout. Dashboard views are saved views of the dashboard surface; viewId puts a widget on one (default: the caller's current view on create, unchanged on update) and layouts are per view. Delete requires id and moves the widget to Trash, where it is deleted permanently after 30 days; the returned trashBatchId identifies the Trash batch it can be restored from, and the source records stay untouched.

action.description: create: name, expectedRevision, idempotencyKey; update: id, expectedVersion, expectedRevision, idempotencyKey; get: ids; delete: id. list requires no other fields. Create also requires the chosen kind's configuration.

calendarQuery.description: Calendar widgets: the records (source), the date field that puts them on days, layout upcoming or month and the IANA time zone.

aggregation.description: month: count the records of each day, or sum amountFieldId.

amountFieldId.description: Optional number or currency field: upcoming shows it beside each record, month sums it per day when aggregation is sum.

dateFieldId.description: Date, date-time, date range or date-time range field of the source list that puts each record on a day. A range puts the record on the day its range starts.

days.description: upcoming: number of days from today on to list, today included.

layout.description: upcoming lists the records of the coming days, with an overdue section for earlier dates; month shows a heat grid of the month with each day's count or sum.

showOverdue.description: upcoming: also list records dated before today; with a range field, records whose range ended before today. Filter out finished records (for example a done status) so only open ones count as overdue.

operator.description: For multiple choice fields in, all and notIn take option values and match records holding any, all or none of them. between uses two inclusive date endpoints in values; overlaps takes the same endpoints and also matches a date range that only partly falls between them; a range without an end counts as its start day. inLastDays and notInLastDays use a positive whole day count in value as a decimal without currency. Range contains tests a point; gt/gte test its start, lt/lte its end. Relative windows begin at UTC midnight that many days before the query clock: inLastDays includes later dates, notInLastDays matches only earlier ones.

anyOf.description: Typed CRM value; only the fields for the selected kind are allowed. A decimal carries a currency, null when it has none. For richText writes send documentJson as a ProseMirror document JSON string, not the Markdown returned on read. A file value lists uploaded file ids in order; the server formats an address value from its parts.

items.description: Typed CRM value; only the fields for the selected kind are allowed. A decimal carries a currency, null when it has none. recordIds.description: Match these terminal record identities after following the path; all steps require record access.

searchFields.description: Limit search to these fields of the list (text, URL, address, formatted text, files, contact details). Omitted searches all of them.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone that sets today and the day of a date-time value, such as Europe/Berlin. Date-only values stay on their calendar date.

displayType.description: number shows the overall result and requires no grouping. areaChart plots a time series and requires groupBy.dateInterval. rankedTable lists groups by value with their share of the total and requires a grouping. funnelChart orders groups by the options of a single-choice grouping field with step-to-step conversion and requires one.

palette.description: accent draws a chart in shades of its first bar colour and a doughnut in a small matched set of colours around it; option colours of a grouping field then show only with useGroupColors true. Without it, groups of a choice field keep their option colours unless useGroupColors is false. New widgets get accent.

showWholePeriod.description: areaChart only: unless false, the axis covers every period of a time filter on the grouped date field (inLastDays, between, gte or gt) up to today or the filter end, with empty periods as zero. false shows only the span between the first and last period with records.

smoothLine.description: areaChart only: true draws a smoothed curve; otherwise straight lines join the periods.

expectedRevision.description: Required for create and update: the current record model configuration revision.

expectedVersion.description: Required for update: the saved widget version as returned by get or list; not accepted on create.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for create and update: a stable retry key; the same request repeats the same key and a different change takes a new key.

kind.description: Widget kind on create: chart (default), activityTimeline, calendar or map. A saved widget keeps its kind.

layout.description: Optional position and size on the 12-column desktop grid. Omit it to keep the current position on update or to place a new widget in the first free spot. It must not overlap another widget.

h.description: Height in rows of 54 px with 12 px gaps, 1 to 24.

x.description: Column, 0 to 11, from the left edge.

y.description: Row from the top. Widgets float up into empty rows above them, as on the dashboard.

mapQuery.description: Map widgets: the records (source) and the address field whose stored location places them, with optional color, size and detail fields.

addressFieldId.description: Address field of the source list. Each record appears at the location the server stored with its address: the building after an address lookup, otherwise the centre of its postal code.

colorFieldId.description: Optional single-choice field whose option colors color the pins and the legend.

detailFieldId.description: Optional field shown in a pin's popover beside the record name and address.

sizeFieldId.description: Optional number or currency field that sizes the pins.

searchFields.description: Limit search to these fields of the list (text, URL, address, formatted text, files, contact details). Omitted searches all of them.

measure.description: Count or aggregate records at source.typeId. Field and relationship references are stable IDs. Group paths and assignee groups use full attribution; the separate overall total counts each source record once. groupBy.dateInterval buckets a date grouping into calendar periods for time series.

dateInterval.description: Bucket a date or dateTime field, system:createdAt or system:updatedAt into calendar periods. Rejected for any other grouping. Weeks start on Monday (ISO). Each group label is the bucket start as a date (YYYY-MM-DD); groups are returned in chronological order and only periods with records appear. Records without a date form the missing group. Every bucket counts toward groupLimit; raise it up to 1000 for long daily series.

fieldId.description: A field ID on the terminal type, system:createdAt, system:updatedAt or system:assignedTo, or null to group by each terminal record. Assignee groups use full attribution: a record with several assignees contributes to each.

filter.description: Limit the terminal records that appear as groups using the same validated filters as record queries. Every path step requires access. Overall totals still use source filters; repeat relevant filters there to limit both contributions and groups.
